About the role How do we know whether a model is safe - and how do we know whether the systems we built to catch misuse actually catch it? Anthropic answers both questions with evaluations. We measure model behavior across misuse, prompt injection, and user well-being to inform training and deployment decisions. We also use AI to investigate potential misuse of Claude, analyzing real-world traffic to surface bad actors and emerging threats that drive enforcement actions. Neither is worth much unless the evaluations behind them are representative, robust, and trustworthy. This role builds the methods and infrastructure that make them so. Sitting at the intersection of applied ML research and engineering, you'll design experiments to improve how we evaluate both model behavior and the agentic systems that govern it, build datasets that represent real abuse rather than clean approximations of it, and ship those methods into the pipelines that gate model training, agent changes, and launch decisions. Responsibilities Evaluation research and methodology. Design and run experiments to improve evaluation quality — developing methods to generate representative test data, simulate realistic user behavior, and validate grading accuracy. Construct RL environments to improve Claude's safety investigation capabilities. Datasets grounded in real harm. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Join the Money Movement team within the Developer product group and help build the infrastructure powering the future of global payments. CDP brings together payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins through a single onboarding flow and self-service APIs. You'll design and build backend systems for stablecoin-based pay-ins, payouts, deposits, and withdrawals, enabling fast, secure, and scalable transfers that underpin how value moves across the Coinbase ecosystem and beyond. What you'll do: Own key projects end-to-end as the Directly Responsible Individual, driving stablecoin-based money movement features from system design through production deployment with high accountability. Build backend systems, infrastructure, and internal/external APIs that enable businesses and partners to embed stablecoin-powered payments into their products. Partner with Product, Design, Infrastructure, and Compliance to translate requirements into robust, scalable solutions that balance speed, security, and regulatory needs. Execute performance, scalability, and reliability improvements across distributed systems, identifying bottlenecks and driving fixes before they impact customers. Support the team's engineering quality through code reviews, architectural best practices, and contributing to patterns that raise the technical bar. Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating backend systems, ideally in fintech, payments, or crypto. Proficiency in backend languages (e.g., Go, Java) and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP), with hands-on experience designing distributed systems and APIs. Track record of serving as DRI for technical projects, driving end-to-end delivery from system design through production deployment. Experience integrating with or building on blockchain or crypto technologies such as stablecoins, on-chain payments, or smart contract platforms (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Base). As an Executive in Residence, you will be a visible industry voice and a trusted peer to senior customer and partner leaders, working alongside our account, technical, product, research, and deployment teams. We are looking for someone security leaders already want to hear from in person and digitally. You bring a recognized reputation, substantive operating experience, and a record of attracting senior audiences through the quality of your ideas and judgment. Your participation should make an industry agenda more compelling and bring the right leaders into the room. You will combine invited speaking and executive engagement with the work needed to move customers from interest to adoption. You will also bring field insights into OpenAI’s cyber efforts and advance selected strategic initiatives agreed with cyber leadership. About OpenAI Cyber Cybersecurity is entering a period of fundamental disruption, and AI creates an opportunity to raise the bar for defense across the entire industry. At OpenAI, we are bringing together frontier research, security products, and partnerships to help defenders scale their expertise, protect more systems, and close the gap between identifying risk and taking action. Our ambition is to make stronger security achievable for organizations of every size and help the industry rethink what effective defense can look like. Joining now means helping shape that transformation while its foundations are still being built. For an experienced security leader, this is an opportunity to turn hard-earned judgment into capabilities that empower defenders worldwide—and influence the standards, practices, and technology that define the next era of cybersecurity. In this role, you will: - Represent OpenAI in consequential industry conversations. Deliver invited keynotes, contribute to substantive panels, and lead executive briefings on AI and cyber defense. Develop original talks and articles grounded in operating experience, evidence, and practical lessons. - Convene senior security leaders. Use your reputation and relationships to attract relevant audiences and host candid CISO dinners, closed-door roundtables, and peer discussions. Build lasting relationships across your region or priority industries. - Help customers make decisions and deploy. Work with account and technical teams to identify priority defensive workflows, build executive sponsorship, address organizational barriers, and shape pilots with clear objectives, owners, and next steps toward deployment. - Bring the field into product and research. Capture customer needs, adoption barriers, and deployment lessons. Translate recurring themes into specific recommendations for product, research, and field teams, and help assess whether changes address the underlying problem. - Advance strategic initiatives. Lead selected projects where your executive experience, industry relationships, or ability to coordinate across teams can accelerate progress. Establish the intended outcome and follow through with the relevant owners. - Strengthen field effectiveness. Help teams prepare for senior security conversations, develop useful executive briefing materials, and turn engagements into sustained relationships and agreed actions. - You will prioritize independently invited thought leadership, major industry forums, and curated executive engagements consistent with the program’s speaking principles. Each engagement should have a clear purpose, an appropriate audience, and an owner for follow-through. You can demonstrate that your participation attracts executive audiences and earns invitations to respected forums. - A strong speaking record and the ability to hold a room, handle unscripted questions, and lead candid peer discussions. Your communication is clear, technically credible, and useful to the audience. - Technical depth to discuss security architecture and defensive operations with practitioners, and the judgment to explain the capabilities, limitations, and implications of AI to executives and boards. - Trusted relationships with CISOs and other senior technology leaders, plus a record of building relationships beyond your existing network. - Experience turning executive alignment into action across teams, with evidence of adoption, deployment, or measurable improvements in security outcomes. - The ability to listen closely, exercise discretion, and represent customer needs accurately. items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Analytics
items.location_text: United States, San Francisco, Canada, New York, Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the founding lead of Agentic Analytics, a new team in our Analytics and Data Insights organization, you'll own how Cohere gets answers from its own data: an agentic analytics system that answers business questions over governed data, shows the source, query, and freshness behind every answer, and asks for clarification or declines when the evidence is insufficient. Agentic analytics is far from a solved problem, and correctness is the hard part. A query that runs can still answer the wrong question. Agents go wrong when a business term maps to more than one table, when data goes stale, and when the right context never reaches the model. The worst failures are silent and plausible: a join that double-counts, a wrong denominator, missing data read as zero. Getting this right takes governed definitions, context an agent can use, and an evaluation bar that decides what ships. You'll build on work already in motion: an internal analytics agent in pilot on our BigQuery warehouse, which is fed by tested ingestion pipelines and modeled in dbt. In your first year, you'll take it to production for teams across Cohere, one domain at a time, and make it replicable: each new domain stands up with configuration, a fresh evaluation set, and very little new code. This is a hands-on staff engineering role reporting to our Senior Director of Data Analytics. You'll write production code and evaluation sets yourself while managing a small founding team that grows as the system proves itself. You may have held the title software engineer, AI engineer, or data scientist; what matters is that you've built a system like this and run it in production. RESPONSIBILITIES As the lead of Agentic Analytics, you will: - Own the system end to end. Set the architecture for how a business question becomes a governed query and a verifiable answer: interpreting the question, retrieving the right context, applying approved definitions and joins, enforcing the asking user's permissions, and attaching the evidence (source, query, freshness) to every answer. - Build and run it in production. Design the core services and write much of the first version yourself: agent-facing data tools (MCP or equivalent), context retrieval, agent skills for analytics, and the APIs that serve answers. Hold them to production standards for reliability, latency, cost, security, and observability. Put it where people already work: Slack, North, IDEs, and other agents. - Hold every release to the evaluation bar. Build and run the evaluation harness, and define what correct means in each domain: ground-truth question sets, including held-out cases and questions the agent should clarify or decline; result-level scoring, correct-or-decline rates, coverage, and error severity; and regression tests on every change to context, skills, or models. Nothing ships below the bar, and the call on when a domain is ready for production is yours. - Engineer the context layer. Turn metric definitions, approved joins, documentation generated from the code that builds each table, a business glossary, and worked examples into context the agent can use. Every correction becomes a reviewed definition and a regression test. - Roll it out across Cohere. Bring domains such as marketing, revenue, finance, and product onto the system one at a time, each with named owners, certified definitions, and its own evaluation set. Measure adoption, accuracy, turnaround, and correction effort against how those teams work today. - Make it replicable. Package the tools, skills, context templates, and evaluations, and document them well enough that other teams at Cohere can run the system without you. - Hire and lead the team. Bring on the team's first engineers, set the technical bar, review the work, and develop the people doing it. - Partner across Cohere. Work with our data platform team on the warehouse and semantic models, our model evaluation team on evaluation methodology, our security team on access, and each domain's owners on definitions and rollout. QUALIFICATIONS You may be a good fit, if you have: - 10+ years building and operating production analytics or software systems, including technical leadership of a team or of systems that span teams - Experience shipping LLM agents to production: tool use, MCP or similar, retrieval and context engineering, guardrails, and observability, with firm opinions on where they fail - Hands-on experience building natural-language or agentic analytics (text-to-SQL, analytics agents, question answering over a semantic layer) that real users relied on, and evidence that it was right - Depth in evaluating LLM systems: golden sets, result-level comparison, abstention metrics, error taxonomies, and regression testing in CI, plus the judgment to tell a good demo from a system you'd put in front of a CFO - Strong Python and SQL, and experience designing and running production services and APIs on a major cloud (Google Cloud is a plus) - Fluency with data: cloud warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), dbt, and semantic layers (MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or similar). items.title: Field CTO, Southern Europe
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going. You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move. WHAT YOU WILL DO Executive engagement Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory. Thought leadership Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations. Conference and event presence Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community. Market feedback Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand. - A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's. - You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions. - You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation. - Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them. - 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company. - Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region. NICE TO HAVE - Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region - Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company - Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Head of Community, EMEA
items.location_text: London, UK, Berlin, Germany, Paris, France
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Community team focuses on finding exceptional power users of our tools and turning real usage into stories and signals that shape both product direction and how the world understands OpenAI. We do that by learning directly from users, then working together to package insights and use cases into formats that can travel: playbooks, webpages, launch assets, event series, and clear guidance on how people actually use our tools. About the Role The Head of Community, EMEA,will lead OpenAI’s community presence across the region and be responsible for setting and evolving an evidence-based Community strategy in markets, including hiring local community leads and managers . The role is responsible for how we create trusted relationships with power users and translate those relationships into participation, insight, enablement, and stories across the region. They will partner with senior leadership to recommend where Community can have the greatest impact across EMEA, laddering up to company and country level priorities. Immediately, they will oversee our Student Collective https://openai.com/student-collective/ motion in EMEA markets, including working with our global team, global agency and hiring Student Community Managers and coordinators in markets. They will also shape how we roll out additional community work with SMBs and Pro subscribers in close collaboration with the global program leads. We’re looking for an experienced community leader who has held senior roles at multiple companies, including those where community is central to how people learn, build, create, or share their work. They understand how to combine thoughtful relationships with programs that can reach many more people. They are comfortable building the first relationships themselves, identifying what makes them valuable, and developing a team that can sustain that quality as the work grows. They bring strong judgement about which communities and fandoms to invest in, how global programs should adapt to local needs, and how community learning can inform decisions across OpenAI. In this role, you will: Build the broader EMEA Community strategy: - Map the EMEA community landscape and develop a point of view on which user communities OpenAI should know, support and learn from. - Build high-trust direct relationships with power users across relevant segments, and help scale that relationship building motion across EMEA where strategically justified. - Define a clear expansion logic: which communities and fandoms to explore, why they matter, what Community can uniquely contribute and what resourcing they require. - Develop country and regional priorities together with country leads, combining local community insights, market context, and company goals. - Create repeatable playbooks for launching, learning from and scaling community programs across EMEA without losing local relevance. Lead regional community programs: - Partner with country leads and local Community teams to develop market priorities and programs, drawing on local user insights and cultural context while maintaining accountability for regional outcomes. - Work with global program leads and country leads to adapt global programs, develop initiatives originating in markets, and share successful approaches across EMEA, with clear expectations for member experience, participation, and learning. - Oversee the Student Collective across EMEA, working with the agency partner and hiring and supporting local Student Community Managers and Coordinators in markets. - Shape and deliver SMB and Pro subscriber programs with global and country leads, including targeted engagement with knowledge worker communities and fandoms where there is a clear opportunity. Turn relationships into participation, insights, and stories: - Source and curate compelling use cases and stories, spotlight community members, and equip them to share their knowledge with wider audiences, helping more people discover practical ways to use AI - Synthesise patterns by market, community, segment and use case; distinguish isolated anecdotes from signals worth acting on. - Publish regular updates and recaps that highlight progress, insights, risks and opportunities and clear recommendations. - Work cross-functionally to route relevant learnings into product, research, brand and product marketing, education, communications,and global affair teams so that these stories and insights can benefit millions more around the world. Operate and scale the function: - Hire, support, and develop regional and market teams needed to grow EMEA Community work, maintaining the quality of user relationships as programs scale. - Work with our global team to build the systems, dashboards, cadences, xfn partners, templates and decision making processes needed to run EMEA Community work well. - Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, clear ownership and follow-through. - Manage multiple workstreams across markets and communities while keeping priorities clear and execution moving. - Identify where additional local capacity, agency support, translation or specialist expertise is needed. - Represent OpenAI credibly with community members, campus partners and regional ecosystem stakeholders. What success looks like: - Strong regional and market community team delivering effective community programs, including the Student Collective and emerging SMB and Pro subscriber initiatives. Clear recommendations on which communities and programs to scale, adapt, pause, or invest in, developed with country leads. - A clear, evidence-based view of which EMEA communities and markets matter most now and next. A practical regional operating model that can scale across markets while preserving local relevance. - High-trust user relationships that lead to robust participation, useful insights, and breakthrough stories, helping OpenAI improve product, marketing, education, and communications decisions while growing advocates in the region. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of experience building, leading or scaling communities, user programmes or ecosystem initiatives across EMEA. - Have experience hiring and developing community teams, managing contractors and agencies, and leading cross-functional workstreams across markets with clear priorities and strong follow-through. - Are an excellent executor who can operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. - Bring strong qualitative judgement and can build trust, identify patterns and turn community signals into clear recommendations. - Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and can influence stakeholders without direct authority. - Are experienced and comfortable working across markets, cultures and time zones, and willing to travel for community activations and relationship-building. - Have a strong interest in AI and practical familiarity with how people use ChatGPT or other AI tools. Preferred qualifications: 1. Experience with student, campus, youth, creator, developer, professional, or other power-user communities. 2. Strong network across relevant EMEA communities, institutions, or ecosystem partners. 3. Experience translating community insight into stories, playbooks, launches, programs, or product recommendations. 4. Fluency in one or more additional EMEA languages. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, US - Remote
items.description: About the Role As an Account Director for Higher Education in AMER, you will own strategic relationships with colleges, universities, and higher education systems as they move from AI experimentation to responsible, institution-wide transformation. You will work with presidents, provosts, CIOs, CTOs, academic and administrative leaders, researchers, security teams, and procurement stakeholders to define priority use cases, build the technical and governance foundation for deployment, and translate institutional goals into a multi-year AI transformation roadmap. You will own the commercial and customer journey end to end—from territory strategy, pipeline creation, and executive alignment through evaluation, procurement, deployment, adoption, consumption, value realization, and expansion. This is a deeply technical, consultative sales role. You will be expected to understand AI capabilities and limitations, integration patterns, data governance, privacy, security, and change management; partner effectively with technical experts; and remain accountable for measurable customer and revenue outcomes after signature. In this role, you will: - Own and execute the AMER higher education territory and account strategy, prioritizing institutions where OpenAI can support meaningful, responsible, and scalable transformation. - Create pipeline and lead complex, multi-threaded new-business and expansion opportunities from first engagement through procurement, deployment, adoption, and value realization. - Engage credibly with presidents, provosts, CIOs, CTOs, academic leaders, researchers, administrators, security teams, legal, procurement, finance, and end-user champions. - Lead cross-functional pursuit and account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Research, Security, Legal, and other functions to design evaluations, pilots, technical validation, executive business cases, production deployments, and adoption plans. - Translate AI model and platform capabilities, limitations, integration approaches, governance requirements, privacy, security, and safety considerations into clear institutional value, credible technical plans, and practical transformation roadmaps. - Own new-business, subscription, and consumption revenue; forecast pipeline and usage-based growth; and use adoption, value realization, and expansion signals to manage the business. - Develop durable executive relationships and a broad coalition of institutional champions across decentralized stakeholder groups. - Bring structured market insight from higher education customers into product, policy, partnership, and go-to-market strategy. - Represent OpenAI as a thoughtful partner at executive forums, industry events, customer advisory discussions, and the broader higher education ecosystem. Qualifications: - 10+ years of experience selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service solutions, with a sustained record of meeting or exceeding meaningful revenue targets through complex, multi-year enterprise sales motions. - Direct experience selling to higher education institutions or systems, with a strong understanding of decentralized decision-making, academic and administrative stakeholders, governance, procurement, privacy, security, and change management. - Demonstrated ownership of consumption- or usage-based revenue, including forecasting usage, driving adoption, creating new use cases, and converting customer outcomes into expansion. - The technical depth to learn complex AI products, lead effective discovery, partner closely with technical teams, explain technical concepts accurately at both executive and practitioner altitudes, and translate them into academic, operational, research, and commercial outcomes. - Experience leading strategic transformations rather than isolated point-solution sales, including governance, change management, adoption, and measurable operational, academic, research, or user outcomes. - Strong executive presence, structured communication, and the ability to earn trust across senior leaders, technical experts, faculty, administrators, and end users. - Excellent account planning, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and cross-functional orchestration skills. - High judgment, curiosity, resilience, and comfort operating through ambiguity, product change, and evolving customer needs. - A mission-driven approach to deploying AI responsibly and helping institutions build durable capability rather than short-lived pilots. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric and start with the institution’s mission, users, constraints, and desired outcomes rather than a predetermined product pitch. - Can move fluidly between a boardroom conversation about institutional strategy and a working session about architecture, data, governance, rollout, and measurement. - Treat the signature as the beginning of the work and are energized by adoption, usage growth, value realization, and expansion. - Are a builder who creates repeatable plays while adapting to the distinctive culture and operating model of each institution. - Bring informed optimism about AI alongside the rigor to surface risks, tradeoffs, and implementation realities. items.title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration. Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs. You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience. Your responsibilities will include: - Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs. - Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration. - Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes. - Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users. There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact. REQUIREMENTS - Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs. - Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers. - Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes. - Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience. Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus. Location: This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

The Growth team’s mission is to drive the expansion of Robinhood's premium and high-value user segments. We focus on optimizing our web presence, funnel experiences, and custom landing pages to acquire and retain highly active customers. By leveraging deep analytical rigor and technical instrumentation, we build seamless transitions from discovery to long-term value. We strive to create sustainable growth pathways that introduce sophisticated financial tools to an ever-expanding customer base! As Senior Product Manager, you will lead critical growth initiatives spanning funnel optimization, subscription services, and custom landing page experiences. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams to implement high-performing user acquisition journeys. You will analyze complex funnel metrics, direct user attribution tracking, and launch targeted cross-sell campaigns to increase user retention. Your work will directly expand our high-value customer base, optimizing critical touchpoints with zero-to-one product features. This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Define and execute the product strategy for our web funnels, SEO landing pages, and customer acquisition experiences. Collaborate with engineering, design, and growth marketing teams to design, build, and launch optimized conversion funnels. Leverage user attribution tracking and data analytics to identify drop-off points and implement measurable conversion improvements. Design and launch cross-sell programs and campaigns that drive the adoption of premium services and subscription offerings. What you bring 4+ years of product management experience, preferably in a fast-paced growth organization, paid marketing growth team, or product-led growth team. A highly technical or analytical educational background, such as a degree in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Proven track record of optimizing digital funnels, managing custom landing pages, and utilizing data-driven attribution models. A strong bias for action, a high level of personal ownership over outcomes, and the ability to make sound product decisions without perfect data. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. items.title: Website Growth Engineer
items.location_text: London, Spain, United States, Poland, United Kingdom
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions. We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers. This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure. Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents. The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked. What you will do - Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue - Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration - Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems - Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance - Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems Requirements - Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies - Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact - Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities - Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics - Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing Bonus - Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer - Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages - Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing - Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows - A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs - Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation - Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function - Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership - Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives Location This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team. You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Recruiter, Communications
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is looking for a Recruiter to partner with our Communications team. This team tells Anthropic's story across corporate, product, executive, and internal communications. In this role, you will be the team's primary recruiter. You will own searches from intake through offer, and you will advise leaders on where the talent is, what it costs, and how to win it. The best communicators are rarely looking, so finding them is the job. As the team grows, you may also support hiring for Brand and Marketing. Key responsibilities Have a passion for AI's potential to positively impact the world, and a realistic view of its risks and limitations Have recruited for communications, PR or adjacent roles, and understand what great looks like in that craft Know how to find and engage candidates who are passive through a variety of creative channels Build trust with senior leaders, and have the confidence to push back with data Write clearly and pay close attention to detail, because candidates and comms leaders will notice both Run a tight, high-touch process that respects candidates' time and helps hiring managers decide quickly Turn hiring data into clear recommendations, not just status updates Thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle executive and confidential searches with discretion Preferred qualifications Have 10+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing senior, hard-to-fill roles Experience hiring for a high-growth technology company whose public narrative matters A network across media, agency, and in-house communications talent Experience supporting executive hiring Experience using AI tools in your daily work, and are curious about where they can take recruiting next The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 — $295,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Solutions Engineer, Ads Solutions - NYC
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity. About the Role We’re looking for an Ads Solutions Engineer to partner with advertisers and agencies throughout the pre-sales and growth lifecycle, helping them successfully evaluate, launch, and scale on OpenAI’s advertising platform. You will serve as the technical expert in the sales process, translating advertiser objectives into scalable technical solutions across measurement, integrations, data activation, and campaign execution. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, and engineering. You’ll work closely with Client Partners, Customer Success Managers, Product, Engineering, Policy, and Operations teams to remove technical blockers, accelerate revenue growth, and shape the future of OpenAI’s ads platform. This role is based in our NYC office and we offer generous relocation support for new hires. In this role, you will: - Partner with Client Partners during the sales cycle to provide technical expertise that unlocks new business and accelerates deal closure. - Lead technical discovery with advertisers and agencies to understand data flows, martech stack, measurement requirements, and activation goals. - Design and recommend implementation approaches for pixels, APIs, server-to-server integrations, identity solutions, offline conversions, and measurement frameworks. - Guide advertisers through onboarding and launch readiness, ensuring successful setup of tracking, attribution, audience signals, and reporting. - Troubleshoot technical issues related to implementation, signal quality, delivery, and measurement performance. - Build compelling demos, proofs of concept, and technical narratives that demonstrate the value of OpenAI’s ads solutions. - Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to escalate issues, advocate for customer needs, and influence roadmap priorities. - Create repeatable technical documentation, playbooks, and best practices that scale advertiser adoption globally. - Help train internal sales and success teams on technical capabilities, integrations, and evolving product features. You will thrive in this role if you: - Have 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, adtech, martech, or a related client-facing technical role. - Have hands-on experience with digital advertising measurement, pixels, conversion APIs, mobile measurement, identity solutions, or CRM/data integrations. - Understand advertiser ecosystems including tag managers, CDPs, analytics tools, attribution platforms, and data warehouses. - Can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders. - Have experience writing SQL, using APIs, debugging implementation issues, or working with structured datasets. - Are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and helping build processes from scratch. - Demonstrate strong ownership, bias for action, and customer empathy. - Care deeply about responsible platform growth, user trust, and long-term partner success. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Head of Experience - Fraud Risk & AML
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our FRAM (Fraud, Risk & AML) Operations function protects our customers, our brands and our licences across multiple regulated markets. As Head of FRAM Experience, you will lead the strategy, governance and integrity of FRAM's insight and management information, shaping how the function experiences its own risk exposure and performance, so FRAM can detect threats early, prove control effectiveness and base decisions on evidence rather than instinct. This is a role where data & insights shapes decisions at the highest level. You will spot emerging fraud, risk and AML trends before they become problems, review the evidence base behind those decisions, and turn complex analysis into clear, commercial recommendations. You will work closely with the Director and senior leadership, with our data and technology teams and the FRAM Change & Tech Leader, align with your fellow FRAM Heads of Department, and represent FRAM's data and insights capability. If you want to move a function from instinct to evidence, this is your opportunity. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Sets and leads the multi-year insights strategy and roadmap for FRAM, aligned to the Director's risk, performance and growth agenda - Establish and govern a single source of truth for FRAM MI, KPIs and dashboards, including data governance, lineage and quality assurance standards - Lead the identification of emerging fraud, risk and AML trends and typologies across our licensed markets, and advise senior leadership on what they mean for the business - Leads the framework for measuring operational performance, customer friction and control effectiveness across FRAM - Provide the analytical evidence and business cases that underpin the Director's strategic and investment decisions - Represent FRAM's data and insights capability to Exco, the Risk Committee and regulators - Partner with data and technology teams, including the FRAM Change & Tech Leader, to secure the platform investment and prioritisation the roadmap needs - Build and grow a team of high performing insights team over time, and foster a culture of curiosity and evidence-based decision making across FRAM OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Deep knowledge of fraud typologies, AML and financial crime risk, and data governance and MI frameworks - Strong hands-on capability with BI platforms, dashboarding and data lineage tooling - Proven experience building or developing insight functions in a regulated or high-growth environment, ideally gambling or financial services - Proven experience leading and developing a small, specialist team - Confidence presenting and defending data integrity and control-effectiveness judgements to senior leadership, committees and regulators NICE TO HAVES - A recognised financial crime or AML qualification (e.g. ICA) - Experience applying advanced analytics or machine learning to fraud and risk detection WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please
